about: Regression for map-mod content being wiped on load (sanitizer ran before the save's map mods were loaded): harness_map places its own cell (h_type 9001) via map_start. Save while on the modded map, reload the way quit-to-menu + load does: the game must come back on the modded map with its state, and the vanilla map (stored in the save) must still be intact when travelling back.
